lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters visible posterior to the gill slits. The middle row displays the highest intensity maxima. A vertical alignment of four spots is prominent immediately posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity are visible, creating a grid-like intersection pattern with the lateral spots, most notably in the mid-flank region between the pectoral and first dorsal fins.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal linear ridge is visible along the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with a high-intensity upper edge and low-intensity lower edge, extending from the post-cranial region toward the first dorsal fin base.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, lower-luminance spots scattered across the medial and posterior surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple low-luminance elongated silhouettes, consistent with commensal organisms, are visible attached to the ventral region and near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
